Walking trails and footbridges bring you close to the cascades. Highlights include Devil's Throat and the natural park surrounding the falls. The guided excursion and entrance tickets are included in the main itinerary; there is no separate admission surcharge in this version.

Early access before the park opens and a helicopter flight are available as optional experiences, subject to advance confirmation of permissions, availability and price. After the walk, a transfer to the airport is arranged ahead of the flight to Buenos Aires.

The waterfall system comprises approximately 275 separate flows set amid tropical forest. One of the main viewpoints is Garganta del Diablo, known as Devil's Throat. Walking along the footbridges reveals the cascades from different elevations. The optional Great Adventure excursion can be booked separately.

From the Brazilian side, Iguazu Falls unfold in a sweeping panorama. Forested banks rise across the river, mist hangs over the gorge, and one torrent after another plunges over the rocky ledges.

A Russian-speaking guide accompanies the group through the national park and its viewing areas. There is time to watch the surging water, spot rainbows in the spray and contrast the calm river above the cascades with the churning torrent below.

In the New Year itinerary, the Brazilian-side visit is included in the tour price. Bird Park and Macuco Safari are offered separately; their terms and prices are listed under the relevant day of the trip.
